description: This file contains unit tests for the DeleteThingDefinitionStrategy class, which is part of a persistence layer handling commands related to deleting 'thing' definitions within a specific strategies/commands package. The tests verify immutability, successful deletion, and error handling when deleting a definition from a 'thing'.

classes.name: DeleteThingDefinitionStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying behaviors of DeleteThingDefinitionStrategy, including immutability, successful deletion, and error handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test instance before each test method.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the DeleteThingDefinitionStrategy class is immutable.

methods.name: successfullyDeleteDefinitionFromThing
methods.description: Verifies that a definition can be successfully deleted from a 'thing', and the appropriate event and response are generated.

methods.name: deleteDefinitionFromThingWithoutDefinition
methods.description: Checks the behavior when attempting to delete a definition from a 'thing' that does not have one, expecting an exception.
